description: A lone biker stands beside a motorcycle on a foggy mountain road at sunrise, wide cinematic shot from the side.

spec.subject: A lone adult biker of average height and lean build, wearing a black full-face helmet, weathered brown leather jacket, dark riding pants, gloves, and boots, standing beside a parked motorcycle with a matte black frame and chrome details.
spec.setting: Foggy mountain road at sunrise; damp asphalt with a pale center line in the foreground, the motorcycle and rider in the midground, and a soft wall of fog swallowing the road and distant hillside in the background.
spec.action: The biker stands still beside the motorcycle, one hand resting on the handlebar while looking down the road.
spec.camera_angle: side profile, eye level, wide shot, 35mm lens, subject placed on the left third of frame with the motorcycle extending toward center.
spec.lighting: Low sunrise light from behind the subject, warm amber highlights on the helmet and bike edges, mist in the air
spec.style: Digital capture with fine grain, restrained natural color grade with warm highlights and cool shadows, realistic road-film look with soft atmospheric haze and muted contrast.
